title: BotDesk_Mobility_Robotaxi_Taxonomy
description: Definitive open-source data schema for autonomous machine-to-machine passenger ride discovery and execution

ride_id.description: Unique session ID generated via rideid.eth

vehicle_id.description: Cryptographic vehicle identifier string mapped to roboride.eth

pickup_location.description: GPS coordinates [latitude, longitude] for consumer pickup

dropoff_location.description: GPS coordinates [latitude, longitude] for destination drop-off

passenger_capacity.description: Available passenger seating capacity via robotaxiclass.eth

dynamic_price_per_km.description: Real-time cryptographically signed pricing metric via riderate.eth

settlement_token.description: Certified handshake token issued by the proprietary BotDesk settlement module
